## A form (in the page)

- **`First Name*` / `firstname`**: `text field`. In `ContactElements` as `FIRST_NAME_INPUT`: `enter().firstName(...)`.
- **`Last Name*` / `lastname`**: `text field`. In `ContactElements` as `LAST_NAME_INPUT`: `enter().lastName(...)`.
- **`Practice Name*` / `company`**: `text field`. In `ContactElements` as `PRACTICE_NAME_INPUT`: `enter().practiceName(...)`.
- **`Phone number*` / `phone`**: `tel field`. In `ContactElements` as `PHONE_NUMBER_INPUT`: `enter().phoneNumber(...)`.
- **`Specialty*` / `specialty`**: `dropdown`. In `ContactElements` as `SPECIALTY_SELECT`: `enter().specialty(option)`.
- **`State/Region*` / `state`**: `dropdown`. In `ContactElements` as `STATE_REGION_SELECT`: `enter().stateRegion(option)`.
- **`Notes` / `form_message`**: `text area`. In `ContactElements` as `NOTES_INPUT`: `enter().notes(...)`.
- **`Contact Nextech`**: `button`. In `ContactElements` as `CONTACT_NEXTECH_BUTTON`: `click().contactNextech()`.
